'''Selross''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] with a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] personality who became the leader of the [[Vosadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Selross led the Vosadii to engage in technological-related criminal activities and involved the clan in surveillance and espionage. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Selross rarely left the [[Vosadii Techno-Palace]] on [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]] due to paranoia regarding the intentions of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the other Hutts of his clan.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
